Smart Reads of the Week: Singapore Dividend Stocks, Rising Payouts, REIT Opportunities, and US Growth
article:
Dividend investors have plenty to pay attention to this week.
Across the SGX, companies are raising their payouts, with some increasing dividends by double digits. But a bigger dividend today is only part of the story. For long-term investors, the more important question is whether the business can keep growing enough to sustain those payouts for years to come.
That is why this week’s Smart Reads goes beyond simply looking for the highest yield. We put Singtel and ST Engineering head to head over a 10-year horizon, examine whether Genting Singapore is becoming a stronger dividend stock, and look beyond blue chips for cash-rich businesses raising their payouts.
There are opportunities outside traditional income stocks too. We explore which REITs could benefit as the Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link draws closer, three stocks for high-earning young professionals building wealth, and the new group of “MANGOS” stocks attracting attention on Wall Street.
Here are this week’s top articles:
Singtel vs ST Engineering: Which Dividend Stock Is Better for the Next 10 Years?
Two Singapore blue chips offer income and growth, but which has the stronger ingredients for the decade ahead?
3 SGX Blue Chips Boosting Their Quarterly Dividends by Up to 25%
These established Singapore companies are giving income investors a meaningful boost with higher quarterly payouts.
Dividend Windfall: 3 SGX Stocks Boosting Payouts by Up to 77.8% This Week
Big dividend increases are catching investors’ attention, but the sustainability of those higher payouts matters just as much.
JB-Singapore RTS Link: These 3 REITs Could Ride the Benefits
The upcoming RTS Link could reshape cross-border connectivity and create opportunities for selected Singapore REITs.
Is Genting Singapore Becoming a Better Dividend Stock?
We examine Genting Singapore’s latest numbers to see whether its income credentials are getting stronger.
3 Stocks to Buy for HENRYs
High earners who are not rich yet have time on their side, making long-term compounding an important part of building wealth.
Beyond Blue Chips: 3 Cash-Rich SGX Stocks Boosting Dividends 10%+
These smaller Singapore companies are raising dividends while maintaining cash-rich balance sheets that could help support future payouts.
Move Over Magnificent Seven: Meet the MANGOS Stocks Driving Wall Street
A new group of market leaders is emerging on Wall Street, but investors should look beyond the catchy acronym before buying.
